caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, stylized plant-like form in the center of a cream-colored background. The plant's stem is rendered in a muted golden yellow with branching fronds and elongated leaves that extend outwards in a balanced arrangement. At the top center, there is a large, heart-shaped cluster that is also golden yellow with several dark pink, eye-shaped ovals and decorative purple curlicues. To the upper left is a smaller flower shape outlined in dark pink and filled with golden yellow, while symmetrical to it on the upper right is an identical heart-shaped form as the upper center one. Below the main stem, on both the left and right, are two grape-like clusters made up of dark pink ovals on golden yellow conical bases, each with fine golden lines radiating outward. The base of the plant is adorned with layered, feather-like forms in alternating golden yellow and dark pink colors, creating a fan shape above a ribbon-like motif in dark pink. The entire design uses only three colors: golden yellow, dark pink, and purple. The drawing is centered on the page, with printed text at the lower edge identifying it as an example of American design found on a priest's vestment from San Gabriel Mission, and noting it as part of the decorative art of Spanish California.
title: San Gabriel Mission Priest's Vestment from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
